title: The Counted Candles

steps.prompt: A coven counts its candles. The total is more than 0 and at most 105. When they group the candles, there are 0 left over when grouped in 3s, 1 left over when grouped in 5s, 1 left over when grouped in 7s. How many candles are there?

reveal_text: The pendulum swings out a word in the dust: 3.
